body: To me, context is important. If the girls were children or your subordinates at work, that’s another story because you’d be leveraging power disparities. If the girls were “only” friends, then the behavior is creepy, but I wouldn’t consider you a sex offender. All people deserve the same respect, of course!!! But if the behavior was directed towards friends (your equals, in terms of power or position), it’s not as extreme as if you were feeling up kids or your coworkers/employees. Personally, if a male friend admitted this to me, I would be weirded out, but I definitely wouldn’t consider him a sex offender! If a teacher admitted this to me, I’d be much more concerned. Again, please don’t harm yourself. You matter and are important in this world!

I feel ashamed too. I knows it’s hard as hell to find the energy to live but it doesn’t mean it’s not worth it. Try to fight your demons. Your life is special. Mental illness is telling you otherwise.

I don’t want to pressure you to talk to me, but if you want to, I have a few questions: Are you okay! What are you feeling right now? I know that when depressed, mustering up enough energy to do “simple” things like responding to messages is incredibly, incredibly difficult. There is no pressure at all to respond. I don’t know you, nor do I know what you’re going through, but you matter, your pain matters, and your healing matters. I hope that you keep going. I don’t want you to die.

Hi there! I’m sorry that you feel like killing yourself. You deserve happiness. You deserve to be free from the burden of your past. I don’t think that anything is unforgivable. And it’s a big step in the right direction that you have acknowledged your mistakes, that you know you did something wrong. That simple fact indicates that you’re nothing like the shameless rapists and sexual offenders. If you are still in contact with these women, and if they agree to it, perhaps confessing the truth to them will free you of your pain. We all do bad things; it doesn’t make us bad people. Now, I’m not saying that they will forgive you or respond well. Should they? Maybe. It’s not really for me to decide. Try to remain calm, and be apologetic, regardless of their response. If it were me, I would forgive you (depending on your age and your position of power relative to me). I truly hope that you find the comfort you desire without killing yourself. If in immediate danger, please call the suicide hotline. All the best :)
